title: Special Variables in Shell
title_vi: Các Biến Đặc Biệt Trong Shell: $?, $$, $!, $@
overview: Learn how to use $0, $#, $?, $$, $!, and understand the distinction between $@ and $*.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: Practice the reviewed shell concepts below. Instructions are independently written; functional requirements follow the linked public lesson.
sections.content_vi: Thực hành các khái niệm shell bên dưới. Hướng dẫn được biên soạn lại; yêu cầu chức năng theo bài công khai được liên kết.

sections.title: Creating Your First Script
sections.content:
Create special_vars.sh to display $0, $1, $2, $@, $# and $$.

`~/project/special_vars.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Script Name: $0"
echo "First Argument: $1"
echo "Second Argument: $2"
echo "All Arguments: $@"
echo "Number of Arguments: $#"
echo "Process ID: $$"
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/special_vars.sh
~/project/special_vars.sh 
```

sections.hint_vi: Kiểm tra tên tệp, trình thông dịch và các trường hợp biên.

verification.command:
python3 - <<'LABEX_CHECK'
import os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
p=pathlib.Path('/home/labex/project/special_vars.sh')
assert p.is_file(), 'Create the requested file first'
text=p.read_text()
assert all(token in text for token in ['$0', '$1', '$2', '$@', '$#', '$$']), 'Required concepts missing'
if True: assert os.access(p,os.X_OK), 'Add execute permission'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='labex-shell-check-') as directory:
    work=pathlib.Path(directory)
    source=p
    if p.suffix == '.sh':
        p=work/source.name
        # Preserve teaching delays in the learner file; suppress sleep only in
        # this isolated behavior probe so a five-second loop does not time out.
        p.write_text(text if False else text.replace('sleep 1', ':').replace('sleep 2', ':'))
        p.chmod(0o700)
        assert subprocess.run(['/bin/bash','-n',str(p)],capture_output=True).returncode == 0
    def execute(arguments, data=''):
        return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',*arguments],input=data,text=True,capture_output=True,cwd=work,timeout=2)
    result=execute([str(p),*[]],'')
    assert all(item in result.stdout for item in ['Number of Arguments: 0']),result.stdout
LABEX_CHECK

sections.title: Understanding `$?` and `$!`
sections.content:
Use exit_status.sh to compare successful/failed ls status and the background PID from $!.

`~/project/exit_status.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo "Running a successful command:"
ls /home
echo "Exit status: $?"
echo "Running a command that will fail:"
ls /nonexistent_directory
echo "Exit status: $?"
sleep 2 &
echo "Process ID of last background command: $!"
wait
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/exit_status.sh
~/project/exit_status.sh 
```

sections.title: Understanding the Difference Between $@ and $\*
sections.content:
In at_vs_star.sh compare "$@" and "$*" using arguments containing spaces.

`~/project/at_vs_star.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
echo 'Using $@:'
for arg in "$@"; do echo "Argument: $arg"; done
echo 'Using $*:'
for arg in "$*"; do echo "Argument: $arg"; done
```

Run:

```bash
chmod +x ~/project/at_vs_star.sh
~/project/at_vs_star.sh 'arg with spaces' another_arg 'third arg'
```
sections.content_vi:
Trong at_vs_star.sh so sánh "$@" với "$*" bằng tham số có khoảng trắng.
